notes.title: Samurai Conqueror Demo is now available! 🎉
notes.notes: [p align="start"][b]The demo of Samurai Conqueror is now available! 🎉[/b][/p][p align="start"]From the Kofun to the Meiji period, legendary heroes gather across time in this historical strategy game.[/p][p align="start"]Choose your hero, expand your power, and experience the first 40 cycles of gameplay.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Download the demo today and take your first step toward unifying Japanese history![/p][p align="start"]We’d love to hear your feedback![/p]
